CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
